internal.title: Internal
internal.remarks: Indicates that the object is reserved for internal use by the platform and cannot be altered by using the Database Configuration application.

extendsobject.title: Extends Object
extendsobject.remarks: The business object that the specified business object extends. Extend an object only when the corresponding entity of the specified business object is a view.

mainobject.title: Main Object
mainobject.remarks: Indicates a main object for business applications and workflows.

siteorgtype.title: Site/Organization Type
siteorgtype.remarks: The organizational level to which the object applies.

entityname.title: Entity
entityname.remarks: The name of the database object upon which the business object depends. The database object can be a table or a view.

eauditenabled.title: E-audit Enabled
eauditenabled.remarks: When checked, indicates that Electronic Auditing (EAUDIT) is enabled for this object.

eauditfilter.title: E-audit Filter
eauditfilter.remarks: User defined filter for an Electronic Audit record

imported.title: Imported
imported.remarks: Indicates that the object was created in the database and imported into the product environment.

servicename.title: Service
servicename.remarks: The name of the start up service for the product on which the business object depends.

persistent.title: Persistent
persistent.remarks: Indicates a persistent object that can be a view or a table. An object must be persistent for you to define an index on it.

textdirection.title: Text Direction
textdirection.remarks: The orientation of text that you enter into fields.

classname.title: Java Class
classname.remarks: The Java class that is used to represent and manage the business object.

hasld.title: Has Long Description
hasld.remarks: Boolean flag to indicate if there is any long description for this record

isview.title: Is View
isview.remarks: True if this is a view, False if this is a table

esigfilter.title: E-signature Filter
esigfilter.remarks: User defined filter for an Electronic Signature

userdefined.title: User Defined
userdefined.remarks: Indicates that the object was created by a user.
